Warning.Subject: Disk almost full on DB-01
Warning.Body: DB-01 is at 92% disk usage. Clear old logs before it hits 100% and the database stops.

Warning.Subject: High CPU on WEB-02
Warning.Body: WEB-02 has been above 90% CPU for 10 minutes. Check for a runaway process.

Warning.Subject: Mail server down
Warning.Body: Customers cannot send mail. MAIL-01 is not responding. Restart it from the admin console.

Warning.Subject: Backup job failed
Warning.Body: Last night's backup did not finish. Run it again before morning.

Warning.Subject: Memory leak suspected on APP-03
Warning.Body: APP-03 RAM usage grows 2% every 10 minutes. Restart the service before it runs out of memory.

Warning.Subject: SSL certificate expires in 3 days
Warning.Body: The certificate for shop.dusk-corp.local expires on Sunday. Renew it or customers will see a security error.

Warning.Subject: Website is down
Warning.Body: The shop shows 'Error 502'. WEB-01 stopped answering. Restart the web service.

Warning.Subject: Packet loss on SW-CORE-01
Warning.Body: The core switch shows 4% packet loss on port 12. Check the cable or the port.

Warning.Subject: Printer queue stuck on floor 2
Warning.Body: The morning shift can't print. Clear the print queue on PRINT-02.

Warning.Subject: UPS battery at 60%
Warning.Body: The UPS in rack B switched to battery after a power dip. If power does not return, servers shut down in 25 minutes.

Warning.Subject: Database is full
Warning.Body: DB-01 hit 100% disk. Orders are failing. Free space now, then restart the database.

Warning.Subject: 5 failed logins on admin account
Warning.Body: Someone tried to log in as 'admin' 5 times from 10.0.4.77. Check if it was a colleague or lock the account.

Warning.Subject: VPN is down
Warning.Body: Remote staff cannot connect. VPN-01 is not answering. Restart the VPN service.

Warning.Subject: Server room temperature rising
Warning.Body: Server room is at 29°C. One cooling unit may have stopped. Check the AC before servers overheat.

Warning.Subject: User locked out
Warning.Body: Sarah from Accounting is locked out after too many wrong passwords. Unlock her account.

Warning.Subject: Slow response on DB-01
Warning.Body: Queries on DB-01 take 4 seconds instead of 0.2. Look for a locked table or a heavy query.

Warning.Subject: Network switch offline
Warning.Body: Floor 3 has no network. SW-03 lost power. Check the PDU in rack C.

Warning.Subject: Server overheating
Warning.Body: APP-02 shut down at 85°C. Fix the cooling, then power it back on.

Warning.Subject: Antivirus definitions out of date
Warning.Body: 12 workstations have not updated their antivirus in 7 days. Push the update from the admin console.

Warning.Subject: DNS not resolving
Warning.Body: Nobody can reach internal sites by name. DNS-01 crashed. Restart the DNS service.

News.Subject: Log4Shell: patch now
News.Body: A critical flaw in Log4j lets attackers run code on your servers. Update to the latest version.

News.Subject: Why backups fail when you need them
News.Body: Most teams never test a restore. Schedule one this week.

News.Subject: How to spot a phishing mail
News.Body: Check the sender address letter by letter. Real IT teams never ask for your password by mail.

News.Subject: Ransomware hits 3 hospitals
News.Body: Attackers got in through an unpatched VPN. All three had no offline backup.

News.Subject: The 3-2-1 backup rule
News.Body: 3 copies of your data, on 2 different media, 1 of them off-site. Simple and still the best.

News.Subject: Why your server room needs a thermometer
News.Body: Most hardware failures in small companies start with heat. A 10 € sensor can save a server.

News.Subject: MFA blocks 99% of account attacks
News.Body: Turning on two-factor login is the cheapest security upgrade you can make.

News.Subject: CEO fraud costs companies millions
News.Body: Scammers pose as the boss and ask for urgent payments or gift cards. Always call to check.

News.Subject: Night shift tips for sysadmins
News.Body: Drink water, check alerts every 15 minutes, and write down everything you change.

News.Subject: Old disks: when to replace them
News.Body: Watch the SMART reallocated sector count. If it keeps rising, the disk is dying.
